set.body: Migrate ordinary PCA and SVD, variational and sparse-functional fitting, direct-sum and hub multiblock fits, and post-fit latent encoding to the common lifecycle or an explicitly typed application-evidence path. Acceptance: every public contract in MathematicalContractCatalog has a real API binding and truthful maturity; every executable estimator returns a bound fitted lifecycle artifact; planned families reject execution explicitly; no convenience API bypasses evidence; JVM and Scala.js parity plus representative numerical oracles remain green.
set.title: Adopt the unified lifecycle across every public multivar estimator
